evidence/body.decision: Operator-level enactment gating is TURNED OFF at the strategy/enactment rung. The War Machine is to be automatic and self-evidencing. Operator engagement moves to DELIVERY: Arxana Field Desk QA notes per enacted click, so the operator can judge whether the machine achieves useful work. Machine gates (tripwires, admissibility, witness, query bounds, warm-up blocker, rollback boundary) are NOT operator gates and remain in force. Scale discipline: 1-2 live runs before any 10-20 campaign.

The one thing I am interested in engaging with are the Arxana Field Desk QA notes... That is the only meaningful time for gating at this level, delivery, not strategy.
